snippet.title: Aegis Protocol | Gameplay Trailer | Point & Click Adventure Game | Demo in Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
Aegis Protocol is a new and my first Point and Click Adventure Game. All game systems were programmed by me as a solo developer on a almost zero budget. With #unity3d,  no third party store assets used. From dialogue tree system, interaction system, file io, inventory, special game systems, animations, pathfinding, every single UI element, puzzles, story were programmed and made by me over the time of 6 months straight. No breaks. The game art was created in a multi layered production process with compositions from AI generated images and textures, models. Sprite Sheet animations in #blender3d  and #mixamo 

Don't forget to 👇
Wishlist on Steam! ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3878860/Aegis_Protocol/
Play the FREE DEMO during #steamnextfest 

Aegis Protocol is a unique blend of classic adventure games and unique humor, a little crafting and action. Explore a rain-soaked, noir-inspired city, interact with a cast of bizarre characters, and uncover a wild conspiracy. 

Features in the Demo:
➤ Classic point-and-click puzzle solving.
➤ A deep, unfolding mystery narrative.
➤ A penguin and a hot chic !

#steamnextfest  #indiegame  #pointandclick  #adventuregame  #rpg  #pixelart  #mysterygame
